page.overview:
Who is Reimi Saionji?

Reimi Saionji is one of the main protagonists of the Star Ocean series, being the deuteragonist of its fourth installment, Star Ocean: The Last Hope. She is a member of the Earth's Space Reconnaissance Force, and as such is the first mate of the spaceship SRF-003 Calnus and serves alongside her childhood friend, Edge Maverick.

Reimi appears in the Final Fantasy series as part of the collaboration between Final Fantasy Brave Exvius and Star Ocean -anamnesis-.

Reimi is a summonable vision and optional playable character. She is a limited-time 4-6★ Raid Summon obtainable during the raid event Vanquish Jie Revorse! (which originally ran from July 27 to August 9, 2018 in the Global version). Her job is listed as Sharpshooter and her role is Physical Damage. She has no innate element or status ailment resistances. Her Trust Master is the passive ability Seed of Hope, which increase the equipped unit's HP by 10% and its resistance to all status ailments (+50%).
